0.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERMARKETREGISTER_00581_ERROR_DISABLE
0.description: My apologies, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>, but we're not able to accept new clientele at present.
0.translation_description: Le chiedo scusa, <hex:020817E905FF0A7369676E6F72696E61FF087369676E6F726503>, ma al momento non possiamo accettare altra clientela.

1.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERMARKETREGISTER_00581_ERROR_RETAINER_COUNT
1.description: It does not appear you have any retainers in your employ at this time.
1.translation_description: Dai nostri registri risulta che al momento non hai servitori alle tue dipendenze.

2.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERMARKETREGISTER_00581_ERROR_RETAINER_CHARGE
2.description: You cannot perform this action until you have purchased the services of an additional retainer.
2.translation_description: Non puoi compiere quest'azione finché non avrai assunto un servitore aggiuntivo.

3.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERMARKETREGISTER_00581_DEFAULT_TALK_01
3.description: Ah, <hex:022903EB0203>. Welcome to Musica Universalis. How may I help you?
3.translation_description: Salve, <hex:022903EB0203>. Ti do il benvenuto a Musica Universalis. Come posso aiutarti?

4.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERMARKETREGISTER_00581_REGISTER_TALK_01
4.description: May I have the name of a retainer you wish to dispatch? The Crystal Exarch has asked that Feo Ul serve as their intermediary. How they would accomplish this, well... I thought it better not to ask.
4.translation_description: Potrei sapere il nome del servitore che desideri mandare? L'Esarca di Cristallo mi ha chiesto di affidare a Feo Ul il ruolo di tramite. Quanto a come riuscirà a farlo, beh... ho preferito non chiedere.

6.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERMARKETREGISTER_00581_REGISTER_SUCCESS
6.description: Very good. I will see to it Feo Ul contact them right away.
6.translation_description: Molto bene. Farò in modo che Feo Ul contatti subito il tuo servitore.

7.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERMARKETREGISTER_00581_REGISTER_ALREADY
7.description: I do believe that retainer has already been dispatched to the Crystarium.
7.translation_description: Mi pare proprio che quel servitore sia già stato mandato al Crystarium.

8.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERMARKETREGISTER_00581_REGISTER_FAILED
8.description: The retainer was unable to meet with Feo Ul.
8.translation_description: Il servitore non è riuscito a incontrare Feo Ul.

9.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERMARKETREGISTER_00581_MAIN_MENU_TITLE
9.description: What would you like to do?

10.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERMARKETREGISTER_00581_MAIN_MENU_REGISTER
10.description: Dispatch a retainer to the Crystarium.

12.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERMARKETREGISTER_00581_MAIN_MENU_CASHBACK
12.translation_description: Visualizzare le aliquote fiscali del mercato.

14.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERMARKETREGISTER_00581_MAIN_MENU_ABOUT_01
14.description: The Crystarium's market is by no means large, but you're more than welcome to sell your wares here.
14.translation_description: Il mercato del Crystarium non è certo grande, ma qui puoi vendere tranquillamente la tua merce.

15.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERMARKETREGISTER_00581_MAIN_MENU_ABOUT_02
15.description: The Crystal Exarch tells me Feo Ul has been charged with retrieving your things, from...where are you from again, exactly?
15.translation_description: L'Esarca di Cristallo mi ha detto che Feo Ul è stata incaricata di recuperare le tue cose... da... da dove vieni, esattamente?

21.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERMARKETREGISTER_00581_NO_CASHBACK
21.description: Tax on items sold in the <hex:02280AFF05546F776EE8020103> markets is the normal rate of <hex:022003E80303>%.
21.translation_description: L'aliquota sulle vendite nei mercati di <hex:02280AFF05546F776EE8020103> è quella normale: <hex:022003E80303>%.

22.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERMARKETREGISTER_00581_CASHBACK
22.description: Tax on items sold in the <hex:02280AFF05546F776EE8020103> markets is reduced to <hex:022003E80503>% until <hex:020703E80303><hex:02082CE4E94E04FF1320022002DC032F022002DE032F022002DF03FF12022002DE032F022002DC032F022002DF0303> (Earth date).
22.translation_description: L'aliquota sulle vendite nei mercati di <hex:02280AFF05546F776EE8020103> è ridotta a <hex:022003E80503>% fino al <hex:020703E80303><hex:02082CE4E94E04FF1320022002DC032F022002DE032F022002DF03FF12022002DE032F022002DC032F022002DF0303> (data terrestre).

23.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERMARKETREGISTER_00581_CASHBACK_ABOUT_01
23.description: To make their markets more attractive to prospective sellers, cities will often lower the percentage of tax that is collected from each sale.
23.translation_description: Per rendere i mercati più attraenti per chi vuole vendere, le città spesso riducono la percentuale di tasse riscossa su ogni vendita.

24.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERMARKETREGISTER_00581_CASHBACK_ABOUT_02
24.description: Reduced tax rate periods can end earlier than indicated if areas require maintenance.
24.translation_description: I periodi con aliquota ridotta possono terminare prima del previsto se alcune zone necessitano di manutenzione.
